baseline_models.focus_anchor: The q-r-hamza pair at words 1/3 surrounds f-r-q at 2, followed by m-k-th at 7 and doubled n-z-l at 8/9.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gathered whole is differentiated into recitable units, held long enough for reception, and repeatedly delivered. Division therefore operationalizes coherence rather than undoing it.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining supply the coherent whole that persists across its portions.
Distribution into parts makes the gathered whole available as a sequence.
Reading and reciting turn each distributed unit into a public event.
Staying with waiting gives each unit receptive duration instead of hurried passage.
Repeated conveying supplies the installment-like movement of the units toward hearers.

changed_reading.before: The ayah says that a scripture was revealed gradually so it could be read slowly.
changed_reading.after: The ayah designs a gathered whole for public use: differentiation, dwelling, recitation, and repeated delivery keep unity active across successive encounters.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence f-r-q at word 2, m-k-th at 7, and n-z-l at 8/9 combines distinction, deliberateness, and placement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distinct units become separately addressable; unhurried reception keeps each unit present; placement assigns each delivery a fitting station. Graduality is qualitative fitting as well as elapsed time.

activation_trace.role: Distinguishing between things makes the delivered units separately discernible.
Composure without haste supplies the receptive manner of each encounter.
Putting a thing in its proper station turns sequence into situated delivery.

changed_reading.before: Gradual descent is merely a chronological description.
changed_reading.after: Each distinguished portion is deliberately placed in a fitting temporal and receptive station.

context_deltas.mechanism: The upstream movement from crumbled remains to renewed creation tests the focus division against destructive fragmentation. The gathered q-r-hamza whole can be portioned without becoming debris because every recitation reactivates a unit within the whole.

activation_trace.role: Gatheredness preserves a whole against the apparent dispersal of its pieces.
Partition supplies the focus-side form of separation whose outcome is being tested.
Pulverization and debris supply the destructive limit-case of separation.
Stirring what was still supplies the reversal from inert fragments to renewed activity.
Bringing creation into being supplies reconstitution rather than mere reassembly.
Newness after cutting supplies the possibility that separation can open renewed form.

structural_cues: 17:98 moves from crumbled bones to being raised as a new creation, and 17:99 repeats creation at cosmic scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fragmentation followed by re-creation; I transfer that sequence to textual reception, where a portion becomes active again when recited. The live alternative is that the sequence concerns resurrection only and offers no textual analogy.

changed_reading.before: Partition is neutral formatting of an already complete text.
changed_reading.after: Partition is productively reversible: each separated unit can be stirred into a new encounter without forfeiting the gathered whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imagined human keeper constricts mercy by holding treasure against expenditure; the focus action moves oppositely by distributing and repeatedly conveying to people. Staging is governed release, not rationing born of scarcity.

activation_trace.role: Distribution into portions supplies release across recipients and occasions.
Repeated conveying gives the release a continuing outward direction.
Tender mercy names the treasury's content and frames its release as beneficence.
Avaricious retention supplies the blocked alternative to staged distribution.
The outflow of property supplies the expenditure that the imagined keeper fears.
Constriction and reduction identify the scarcity posture reversed by delivery.

structural_cues: 17:100 imagines mercy treasuries under human control before 17:105-106 repeatedly name descent and public recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, feared expenditure, constriction, and later distributed descent; I assign the contrastive arrow from hoarding to generous release. The live alternative is that 17:100 diagnoses avarice without specifying the delivery logic of 17:106.

changed_reading.before: Successive portions may look like restricted or incomplete access.
changed_reading.after: Successive portions enact sustained generosity: what humans would hoard is repeatedly released in receivable measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs, disclosed knowledge, insight, and truth that fits its locus converge on the focus branch of proper placement. Differentiation makes signs discernible, while descent seats each sign where it can become perception.

activation_trace.role: Distinction makes the successive units perceptually and semantically discriminable.
Proper placement supplies the mechanism that fits each disclosure to a station.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the desired effect of differentiation.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the transition from delivered sign to recognized knowledge.
Sending down and conveying directly associates delivery with the insight-signs in this ayah.
Inner sight supplies the receptive capacity that a fitted disclosure activates.
A truth matching its proper joint or receptacle reinforces exact fit rather than bare chronology.

structural_cues: 17:101 calls the signs clear, 17:102 says they were sent down as insights, and 17:105 repeats that the truth was sent down and descended.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, knowledge, insight, matched truth, and proper placement; I infer a pedagogical arrow in which delivery is fitted to reception. The live alternative is that these terms characterize the signs' truth while timing remains incidental.

changed_reading.before: The portions arrive at different times.
changed_reading.after: The portions are fitted disclosures: each differentiated unit is placed so truth can become a discernible sign and inward sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coercive destabilization is followed by dwelling and the gathering of mixed groups. Against that sequence, dividing the text for people is not social scattering: recurrent portions become common stations where heterogeneous hearers can gather without losing difference.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the cohesive pole of the focus text's part-whole architecture.
Distribution into units supplies differentiation without requiring social dispersal.
The human collective anchors the part-whole mechanism in a public rather than merely textual field.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the coercive scattering pressure.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the counter-movement toward cohesion.
Dwelling in a home supplies stable emplacement after attempted dislocation.
Mixed elements wrapped into one group supply cohesion that preserves heterogeneity.

structural_cues: 17:103 attempts removal from the land; 17:104 answers with dwelling and eventual arrival as a mixed group; 17:106 directs the differentiated recitation to people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destabilization, gathering, settlement, mixture, and a text divided for people; I map the spatial-social sequence onto textual architecture. The live alternative is that 17:103-104 remains historical movement with no claim about how recitation gathers audiences.

changed_reading.before: Dividing the text primarily separates material into manageable units.
changed_reading.after: Differentiated units can serve as recurring common stations that gather mixed hearers without flattening their differences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus downward delivery passes through paced recitation into a second descent: hearers fall, prostrate, and increase in humility. Revelation's trajectory is completed not merely by arrival in language but by changed bodily orientation.

activation_trace.role: Downward movement and settling supply the first leg of the descent.
Recitation supplies the relay between delivered words and responding bodies.
Following in succession supplies the audible sequence that initiates response.
A sounding, unstable fall converts semantic descent into bodily downward motion.
Lowering and submission give the fall a receptive rather than accidental direction.
Increase and growth make repeated reception cumulative rather than momentary.
Lowering and humility name the inward disposition produced alongside bodily descent.

structural_cues: 17:107 places recitation immediately before falling in prostration; 17:109 repeats the fall and adds increasing humility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated downward motions and their sequence; I supply the relay arrow from revelation's descent through recitation to bodily descent. The live alternative is a compositional parallel rather than a causal completion.

changed_reading.before: Descent ends when the revealed material reaches the reciter and audience.
changed_reading.after: Descent continues through recitation into the hearer's posture, where repeated portions lower the body and deepen humility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to avoid both raised proclamation and hidden voice, then seek an intervening path, supplies an acoustic analogue for m-k-th. Deliberate public reading governs amplitude as well as tempo so speech remains audible without becoming coercive.

activation_trace.role: Reading aloud supplies the vocal practice to which acoustic calibration can attach.
Composure without haste supplies the focus anchor for measured delivery.
Publicly raising the voice supplies the upper acoustic extreme.
Secret or lowered speech supplies the lower acoustic extreme.
Seeking supplies deliberate adjustment rather than an automatic midpoint.
A middle condition supplies the calibrated range between opposed volumes.
A traversable path turns moderation into a sustained practice of delivery.

structural_cues: 17:110 brackets vocal practice between two negated acoustic extremes and commands an intervening way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vocal extremes, a sought middle, and focus composure; I broaden temporal pacing into acoustic calibration. The live alternative is that 17:110 governs prayer voice independently and leaves m-k-th purely temporal.

changed_reading.before: Reading over m-k-th means only slowing the temporal pace.
changed_reading.after: Reading over m-k-th is composed delivery: timing and audibility are calibrated together for non-coercive public reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the lexically remote guest-provision branch of n-z-l. It remains anchored by people, prolonged stay, and recitation in the focus ayah; downstream prose should present it only as a hospitality analogy, not as the clause's lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: People at word 5, m-k-th at 7, and n-z-l at 8/9 allow the delivered portion to be imagined as provision for those who stay with the recitation.

activation_trace.role: Provision prepared for a guest supplies the hospitality image for each installment.
Staying and waiting supply the guest-like duration in which provision is received.
Familiarity that removes estrangement supplies the social effect of hospitable delivery.
Recitation supplies the encounter in which prepared provision is offered and received.

changed_reading.before: Installments are units sent toward an audience.
changed_reading.after: Each installment can be carried as provision prepared for listeners who dwell with the recitation, turning delivery into hospitality that reduces estrangement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the bridge is a compositional echo rather than a shared lexical branch. It remains anchored in the doubled n-z-l construction at the focus close and the doubled k-b-r construction at the window close; downstream prose should qualify it as rhetorical activation, not a causal or grammatical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb-plus-verbal-noun n-z-l pair at words 8/9 is answered at the window close by the k-b-r pair in 17:111.

activation_trace.role: Repeated conveying gives semantic movement to the focus verb-plus-verbal-noun intensification.
Uttered speech makes the closing magnification an enacted vocal response.
Magnifying something inwardly supplies the semantic endpoint of the echoed construction.

changed_reading.before: The emphatic descent formula closes the focus ayah without a local formal response.
changed_reading.after: The staged descent can be heard compositionally as moving toward voiced magnification: delivered intensification is answered by enacted intensification.

strongest_changes: Differentiation became sustained release rather than fragmentation or scarcity.
Chronological graduality became fitted disclosure aimed at discernment and inward sight.
Revelation's descent continued through recitation into falling, prostration, and increasing humility.
M-k-th expanded from tempo alone to a possible calibration of tempo and audibility.
summary.what_was_special: The window repeatedly opposes hoarding, scattering, destabilization, and blocked reception to measured release, gathering, placement, and response; its sharpest surprise is the relay from textual descent to the hearers' bodily descent.
remaining_uncertainties: The regenerative and hospitality models depend on explicit but branch-distant analogies and should remain exploratory.
The acoustic reading depends on whether 17:110's prayer-voice instruction legitimately broadens the focus pacing phrase.
Proper placement is a packet branch of n-z-l, but the ayah may foreground repeated delivery more than situational fit.
The closing descent-magnification echo may be compositional patterning without an interpretive arrow.
